kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نقتحم (form VIII)
# نَقْتَحِمُ (naqtaḥimu) /naq.ta.ħi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# نُقْتَحَمُ (nuqtaḥamu) /nuq.ta.ħa.mu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# نَقْتَحِمَ (naqtaḥima) /naq.ta.ħi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# نُقْتَحَمَ (nuqtaḥama) /nuq.ta.ħa.ma/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
